articles.title: Supreme Court acquits man after 22 years in jail for wrongful conviction
articles.description: After enduring twenty-two long years of wrongful imprisonment, a man was finally acquitted by the Supreme Court. The injustice stemmed from the trial court's flawed evidence analysis, compounded by the High Court's refusal to entertain his delayed appeal. The Supreme Court emphasized how marginalized communities often find access to justice frustratingly elusive, shedding light on the pressing issues within the judicial system that disproportionately affect the underprivileged.

articles.title: BCCI to standardise Bronco, 2K fitness test parameters after ENG tour debacle
articles.description: The Indian team went through a change in fitness testing drills after Adrian Leroux replaced Soham Desai as the strength and conditioning coach last year. It is learnt that the BCCI medical team, which includes the CoE and the Indian team, has struggled to work in sync to assess the fitness of players. Since Leroux took over, it was decided that the Bronco test would be the primary test to judge fitness instead of the Yo-Yo test.

articles.description: Candace Owens is facing renewed criticism after a viral X post accused her of dragging innocent people into her coverage of the Charlie Kirk investigation and promoting conspiracy theories. The criticism came as Owens addressed claims involving Frank Turek, saying viewers could judge his remarks for themselves, while previewing updates about Officer Bagley and Alan Robertson. The exchange has fueled fresh debate over her reporting style and the evidence behind her claims.

articles.title: AICTE opens applications for fully funded Mitacs Globalink Research Internship 2027 in Canada
articles.description: AICTE has launched applications for the AICTE–Mitacs Globalink Research Internship 2027, a programme that will provide up to 300 Indian undergraduate students each year with fully funded 12-week research internships at Canadian universities. Applications are open from August 5 to September 16. Eligible candidates will undergo a selection process before undertaking research placements between May and October 2027 across a range of academic disciplines.

articles.title: NEET UG counselling 2026: What is the difference between AIQ and state counselling?
articles.description: The Medical Counselling Committee has opened registration for NEET UG 2026 counselling. Students can register on the official website until August 12 for admission. This counselling round is for the All India Quota, covering 15% of medical seats. State counselling will handle the remaining 85% of seats separately. Nursing and Ayush course counselling will also follow different procedures.

articles.title: RRB ALP CBT 2 answer key released at rrbapply.gov.in; objection window open until August 11, 2026
articles.description: The Railway Recruitment Board has released the provisional answer key, question papers and response sheets for the RRB ALP CBT 2 examination conducted on July 28, 2026. Candidates can download the documents using their login credentials and raise objections until August 11 by paying Rs 50 per question. The final answer key and scorecards are expected in September 2026, followed by the Computer-Based Aptitude Test schedule.
